locations.label: Upstairs Jugger-Nog
locations.description: Open the farmhouse, take an MP5 when you can afford it and work toward Jugger-Nog upstairs. Speed Cola is downstairs; the Box sits on the upper balcony. Learn the balcony drop before you use it under pressure, then move away from its landing point. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Balcony Mystery Box

locations.label: Upstairs Double Tap
locations.description: Quick Revive is outside near the barn and Double Tap is upstairs in the barn. Perks already have power. Use the barn doorway and upper opening as two different exits, checking the ground before dropping. The photographed barn is a shared TranZit layout reference; this standalone mode has different equipment. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
